stories.title: Energy price cap to rise 4% from October, taking typical bill to £1,723
stories.summary: Energy bills for households on default tariffs will rise by 4% from 1 October, taking a typical annual bill to £1,723. Ofgem announced the new price cap on Wednesday morning, covering the period from 1 October to 31 December. stories.title: Competition watchdog issues five money-saving tips for drivers at end of summer holidays
stories.summary: Drivers heading home at the end of the summer holidays are being told to compare fuel prices before filling up and to read car park signs carefully. stories.title: Welsh drug testing service detects new class of synthetic opioid for the first time
stories.summary: A class of synthetic opioid that Wales’s drug testing service had never detected before has been found in samples submitted by people who believed they had bought heroin.
